sources.title: nemotron-3-embed-1b Model by NVIDIA | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: Precision: BF16 and NVFP4 The Nemotron-3-Embed-1B-BF16 model is a transformer-based text embedding model trained with bidirectional attention masking, where the final embedding vector is obtained by applying average pooling to the transformer's token-level representations. It encodes each input text into a dense embedding vector of dimension 2048.
